response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count, AVG(rc.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE rc.rental_count > oa.avg_count
